role: Read-only prospective information-ceiling and exact-implementation-cost matrix for all J7S same-first alternatives; no second-law or information evaluation
question: Which, if any, of the twelve positive same-first initial-error alternatives has a non-negligible binary-error information ceiling under the already declared sparse IID prior and can fit a two-action exact full-second-law calculation within the inherited 65,536-term ceiling?
source_basis: J7S exhaustive first-record masses and p_X=1/10 restricted-pair prior
J7M complete second public flux and unchanged two public actions
J7E full_law denominator, one-site and complete-assignment evaluation structure

frozen_model.geometry_and_channel: Same paper-normalized periodic L=2 D4 ideal-projector first record and IID 36-red-edge p_X=1/10, p_Z=0 physical prior as J7S; no new candidate error or rate.
frozen_model.first_record_and_actions: J7M complete full-binary first charge/flux/vacuum record, base private error [0,4,3], and the same relation-free public corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35]. Both actions have 22 flux-eligible second public charge sites.
frozen_model.private_boundary: Initial error identity, its support and prior weight are private generation/analysis fields. An online action receives only the common complete first public record and declared correction; no private field is passed to it.
frozen_model.prior_interpretation: For each separate base-versus-candidate binary toy, restrict the already declared IID prior to those two supports and condition on the same first record. Binary entropy H(E|first,pair) is an upper bound on any later record's information about that pair identity. It is not information under the full IID channel or a logical-risk quantity.

matrix.candidate_rows: All 12 J7S positive candidates, no omission or new candidate selection
matrix.cost_formula: For candidate first-variable count v and action-specific second-variable counts k0,k1, current exact full_law code spends one initial first-mass 2^v plus, for each action a, one denominator 2^v, 22 one-site checks each 2^(2v+1), and every one of 2^ka complete rows at 2^(2v+ka) terms: T=3*2^v+44*2^(2v+1)+2^(2v+2k0)+2^(2v+2k1). This is a term projection conditional on the unknown actual k0,k1, not a computed second law or mathematical lower bound on other algorithms.
matrix.selection_rule: Compare exact restricted-pair posterior weights and binary entropy ceilings for all 12. Retain every candidate attaining maximal entropy among those with at least one k0,k1 cell strictly below the inherited 65,536-term ceiling; report ties as peer branches. The J7S lexicographic candidate remains a structural control and is not silently substituted.
matrix.risk_dependency: No unconditional paired logical-risk target is inferred; that separately needs full-channel attempted-history denominator, matched physical/first/second-exogenous keys, private Boolean-union score and uncertainty.

acceptance: All five source/result pins pass before and after
Replay J7S's 12 positive same-first candidates and J7M's two equal 22-eligible-site second flux records
Evaluate all 12 posterior weights and entropy ceilings at the already declared rate, and all 36 k0/k1 cost cells per candidate without Born evaluation
Apply the registered maximal-entropy-with-at-least-one-under-cap selection rule and preserve every tie
Report the current implementation's conditional cost, not a proof of algorithmic impossibility; no information gain, risk or policy claim

outcomes.peer_candidates: Register a separate small exact conditional second-site-count preflight for all selected peers before full-law terms; retain the rare lexicographic control.
outcomes.none_under_cap: Do not raise the inherited ceiling; seek a separately registered algebraic reduction or stop this exact engine branch.
outcomes.censored: On pin, row, flux, cost-formula or CPU mismatch, release no candidate selection.

stop_rule: Stop after 432 deterministic arithmetic cost cells and 12 entropy ceilings. No new exact Born term, second law, stochastic history, arm, bootstrap, threshold or budget increase.
